top_signals.title: Oil Slides as Traders Weigh Signs of Tentative Iran Diplomacy
top_signals.summary: Oil eased as fresh diplomatic efforts in the Middle East eroded some risk premium associated with a resumption of US military strikes on Iran.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: AI Creating New Pathways to Engage Clients, Says Schwab CEO
top_signals.summary: Schwab president and CEO Rick Wurster said that AI integration is helping the company streamline operations and create 'new pathways to engage with clients' after the Schwab announced investment in AI startup Nevis. Wurster also commented on the AI investment landscape, saying that he is reassured that there isn't a bubble by AI related companies that are still fairly or undervalued.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Polymarket suspended trading amid reports of user funds being drained
top_signals.summary: The prediction markets platform halted trading on Thursday after it reported one of its third party providers had been compromised.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
